industry_links: NOT FOUND (RUCT records 0 ECTS of prácticas)
notes: On the evidence gathered this is the strongest practical fit in the batch for this candidate: official máster universitario, 60 ECTS in one year, ENGLISH-taught, presencial option available (choose it — the virtual variant is a student-visa problem), and Ingeniería Informática named explicitly as an admitting degree with no complementos. It is also the ONLY programme in the batch that publishes its non-EU price outright, which makes the budget knowable: 2.913 € + 218,15 € ≈ 3.131 € for the year. Per-ECTS figure 2.913 / 60 = 48,55 EUR is my arithmetic from the published total. Presencial and virtual appear to share the single RUCT code 4315875 (40 places, 20 per modality) — not separately confirmed on the register.

notes: CONJUNTO entry, as asked. PARTICIPATING UNIVERSITIES — all three named in the RUCT title: 'por la Universidad de Burgos; la Universidad de León y la Universidad de Valladolid'.
